component.name: Matt|Pad
component.summary: Markdown editor with templates and themes for authors
Markdown-Editor mit Vorlagen und Themes für Autorinnen und Autoren
Editor Markdown con plantillas y temas para autoras y autores
Editor Markdown com modelos e temas para autoras e autores

description.p: Matt|Pad is a simple Markdown editor: formatting appears as you type, and the interface is as clear as a classic text editor.

ul.li: Templates and themes as plugins – e.g. for book chapters
Printing and export to PDF and HTML in the chosen theme
Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese and German
Spell checking: Spanish, Portuguese, English, German
Tabs, find and replace, outline, full screen

description.p: First release as Matt|Pad: plugins for templates and themes, four interface languages, installers for Windows, macOS and Linux.
